## Module 06. 基因组轨迹可视化 (Gviz)

展示当前主差异集合中最显著 Peak 的局部覆盖。所有样本均读取上游 RPGC bigWig，并使用相同纵轴范围；轨道是归一化可及性浏览图，不能替代组间统计检验。

```{r gviz_track, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
track_files <- file.path(work_dir, "05bigwig", paste0(samples, "_RPGC.bw"))
names(track_files) <- samples
track_status <- data.frame(Status = "SKIPPED", Reason = "No primary differential peaks", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
remove_output_with_preview(step_plot_file("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track.pdf"))
unlink(c(step_table_file("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track_Skipped_State.csv"),
         step_table_file("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track_Input_and_Scale.csv")))

if(nrow(res_df) == 0) {
  write_skipped_state("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track", track_status$Reason)
} else if(!all(file.exists(track_files))) {
  track_status$Reason <- paste("Missing canonical RPGC bigWig:", paste(samples[!file.exists(track_files)], collapse = ", "))
  write_skipped_state("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track", track_status$Reason)
} else {
  top_peak <- res_df[which.min(res_df$SelectedSignificanceValue), , drop = FALSE]
  plot_chr <- ensure_ucsc_seqnames(as.character(top_peak$seqnames))
  from <- max(1L, as.integer(top_peak$start) - 2000L)
  to <- as.integer(top_peak$end) + 2000L
  chr_length <- GenomeInfoDb::seqlengths(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.refGene)[plot_chr]
  if(length(chr_length) == 1L && !is.na(chr_length)) to <- min(to, chr_length)
  positions <- seq.int(from, to)

  read_rpgc_region <- function(path) {
    bw <- rtracklayer::BigWigFile(path)
    bw_seqinfo <- GenomeInfoDb::seqinfo(bw)
    aliases <- unique(c(plot_chr, sub("^chr", "", plot_chr)))
    bw_chr <- aliases[aliases %in% GenomeInfoDb::seqlevels(bw_seqinfo)]
    if(length(bw_chr) != 1L) stop("Cannot uniquely match chromosome in RPGC bigWig: ", path)
    query <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(bw_chr, IRanges::IRanges(from, to))
    signal <- rtracklayer::import(bw, which = query)
    values <- numeric(length(positions))
    if(length(signal) > 0L) {
      if(any(!is.finite(signal$score))) stop("Non-finite RPGC values: ", path)
      for(i in seq_along(signal)) {
        first <- max(from, BiocGenerics::start(signal)[i])
        last <- min(to, BiocGenerics::end(signal)[i])
        if(first <= last) values[seq.int(first, last) - from + 1L] <- signal$score[i]
      }
    }
    values
  }

  track_result <- tryCatch({
    signal_matrix <- vapply(track_files, read_rpgc_region, numeric(length(positions)))
    common_ylim <- c(0, max(1, signal_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)
    axis_track <- Gviz::GenomeAxisTrack()
    gene_track <- Gviz::GeneRegionTrack(
      TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.refGene, chromosome = plot_chr, start = from, end = to,
      name = "Genes", transcriptAnnotation = "symbol", background.title = viz_pal$accent["warm"]
    )
    data_tracks <- lapply(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
      track_colour <- unname(viz_pal$group[as.character(conditions[i])])
      Gviz::DataTrack(
        start = positions, end = positions, data = signal_matrix[, i],
        genome = "mm39", chromosome = plot_chr, type = "histogram",
        name = paste(samples[i], "RPGC"), col.histogram = track_colour,
        fill.histogram = track_colour, ylim = common_ylim
      )
    })
    tracks <- c(list(axis_track, gene_track), data_tracks)
    tracks <- lapply(tracks, function(track) {
      Gviz::displayPars(track) <- list(
        fontfamily = atac_figure_font_family, fontfamily.title = atac_figure_font_family,
        fontsize = atac_figure_tick_size, cex = 0.7, cex.axis = 0.7, cex.title = 0.55,
        fontface.title = 1, rotation.title = 90
      )
      track
    })
    save_step_table(data.frame(
      Sample = samples, BigWig = unname(track_files), Normalization = "RPGC",
      Chromosome = plot_chr, Start = from, End = to,
      SharedYAxisMin = common_ylim[1], SharedYAxisMax = common_ylim[2],
      RegionalMean = colMeans(signal_matrix), RegionalMax = apply(signal_matrix, 2, max),
      EvidenceRole = "normalized locus visualization, not a differential test",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ), "Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track_Input_and_Scale.csv")
    if(should_render_plots()) {
      track_title <- sprintf("Primary differential peak: %s:%s-%s (RPGC; shared y-axis)", plot_chr, from, to)
      draw_gviz_dual(
        step_plot_file("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8,
        Gviz::plotTracks(tracks, from = from, to = to, chromosome = plot_chr,
                         main = track_title, cex.main = 0.8, fontface.main = 1, margin = 4)
      )
    }
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    track_status$Reason <<- conditionMessage(e)
    FALSE
  })
  if(isTRUE(track_result)) {
    track_status$Status <- "COMPLETED"
    track_status$Reason <- "Canonical RPGC bigWigs; same genomic interval and y-axis across samples"
  } else {
    write_skipped_state("Step6", "Top_DiffPeak_Track", track_status$Reason,
                        clear_plot_files = "Top_DiffPeak_Track.pdf")
  }
}
save_step_table(track_status, "Step6", "Genome_Track_Status.csv")
```
